description: Spin-sector realisation: the two sides of Schur-Weyl for the SU(2)-reachable 2-row blocks of n=5. The corpus W_lambda uses the Hecke (S_n-side) hook-content q-dimension d_q(lambda); the WRT/Poincare modular data uses the SU(2) (centralizer-side) quantum dim [2j+1]_q. They are dual but DIFFERENT, so WRT=W_lambda is a category error. The keystone link is Schur-Weyl DUALITY. No fit.
key_fact: d_q^Hecke(lambda) != [2j+1]_q^SU(2) in general (coincide only at (4,1)); muon (3,2): [5]_q=5.22 vs [2]_q=2.01
verdict: W_lambda is the Hecke/S_n side of Schur-Weyl; the WRT(S3/2I) modular data is the SU(2)/centralizer (V_lambda) side. They are Schur-Weyl DUAL (paired by (C^2)^{⊗n}=⊕ S^λ⊗V_λ) but NOT equal. A direct WRT=W_lambda equality is a category error. The Poincare sphere is the icosahedral SELECTOR of the modular data; the W_lambda numbers are the dual S_n-side q-dimensions. No closer identity at the weight level. This is the deflationary terminus of the WRT line.
arc_assessment: Genuine exact gains (Sasakian ruled out; angles explicit + Lean phi pin; W_lambda reproduced; WRT operational; link=Schur-Weyl duality). NOT achieved: closure of conj:s5-so3-fiber-action or any mass prediction. Standing caveats: muon/electron spin/colour split is a consequence of the posited home-block assignment, non-monotone vs mass ordering, no clear physical reading.
